_comment: Features switched off in this build. Not user settings — a setting is a choice the
user makes and can change, these are capabilities this fork does not ship.
Plain JSON because src/ mixes renderer ESM with main-process CommonJS, and both
sides need the same answer: the main process to refuse to start the machinery, the
renderer to stop offering controls for something that cannot happen.
autoUpdate: the update feed points at OpenWhispr/openwhispr — upstream. An update
here would replace this fork with a build that has none of its changes. Re-enabling
means pointing the feed at a repo that publishes THIS build; flipping the flag alone
meetingDetection: automatic detection of meetings via mic usage, running processes
and calendar reminders, all of which existed to raise a prompt. The mic listener is a
Swift sidecar that ran for the whole session and the process detector polled, so both
were pure cost. Starting a meeting note deliberately — the meeting hotkey, the tray —
